expires_today.title: VFX Master-Bundle For Unreal
expires_today.description: Discover the very best in VFX
expires_today.long_description:
Crank up the volume on your next game or video with the VFX Master-Bundle for Unreal Engine. This gigantic library of high-quality assets from VRhinoFX gives you the dynamic VFX effects you need to add Hollywood-quality polish to your creative projects. Cast a charm on your players with the powerful RPG - Magic VFX collection, which features Holy Light, Blood, Fire, Poison, Darkness, and Lightning—pay what you want for realistic magical explosions and help support Make-A-Wish, too!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before June 5th, 2027.

expires_today.title: The John Scalzi Collection: Old Man's War & More by TOR Books
expires_today.long_description: If you’ve been sleeping on master storyteller and acclaimed humorist John Scalzi, or if you simply have the need to add more of his work to your library, boy do we have the perfect bundle for you! We’ve partnered with TOR to bring you the best that Scalzi has to offer, from epic extraterrestrial war sagas to parodies or your favorite sci-fi series. Join the fight with the geriatric warriors of Old Man’s War, given newer, younger bodies to fight an offworld conflict that soon proves more complex than it seems! Learn the ins and outs of supervillainy with the world’s newest bad guy in Starter Villain! Discover free will with the doomed ensigns aboard a starship in the Star Trek spoof Redshirts! There are so many more worlds, characters, and self-aware jabs at your favorite sci-fi franchises to discover in this bundle, so grab it now at the price of your choice and support World Central Kitchen with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Summer Games Done Quick 2026
expires_today.long_description:
We love to take our time savoring a great game, but we also love the high-octane thrill of speedrunning our way to the end. If you’re also one of those people, and you’re looking forward to speedrunning marathon Summer Games Done Quick 2026, now’s the time to dive into some prep work with some of the games featured at the event! In this bundle you’ll find games like Solar Ash, a stylized action-adventure game full of gravity-defying challenges and thrilling boss battles! Or take on Bomb Rush Cyberfunk, a thrill ride on wheels that’s just as groovy as its title suggests! Or grab a friend and enjoy the Mega Man-inspired action of roguelike co-op 20XX! There’s even more to explore in this bundle celebrating Summer Games Done Quick 2026, so grab it now and grab it fast, and support Doctors Without Borders with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem Grandma, No! and The Gunk before January 24th, 2027. Redeem all others before July 24th, 2027

expires_today.title: Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow and More! by DC Comics
expires_today.description: It’s a bird! It’s a plane! It’s Supergirl!
expires_today.long_description:
If you’ve found yourself in serious need of comics after seeing DC’s superhero smash Supergirl, or if you want to give yourself a crash course before buying tickets, we’ve got a Supergirl comic bundle just for you! Collected here are the Girl of Steel’s most iconic adventures and essential arcs including all five volumes of Jeph Loeb’s beloved run, all six volumes of Supergirl’s New 52 rebrand, and all four books of Peter David’s delightfully surprising riff on the character. And it looks like a few issues starring a certain alien bounty hunter and a superpowered canine snuck in here too! Whether you’re a new fan or an old friend of the Girl of Tomorrow, grab these comic collections at the price of your choice, and support the real heroes at the Book Industry Charitable Foundation with your purchase!

The titles in this bundle are available through neonichiban.com. To access the content, create or log in to your neonichiban.com account.

expires_today.title: Arc System Works: Evo Collection
expires_today.description: Play Fighting Games. Fight for Something Bigger.
expires_today.long_description:
What’s better than getting a collection of fighting games from Arc System Works in celebration of Evo 2026? Supporting the fight against rare disease while you’re at it. Throw hands in style with big-time fighting games that dominate the competitive scene. Dive into an epic bundle of Guilty Gear titles highlighted by the dynamic 2D x 3D hybrid Guilty Gear -STRIVE-, alongside all five available Season Passes. Or challenge your skills in competitive staples like BlazBlue: Central Fiction and Under Night In-Birth II. Your bundle purchase supports the Raiden Science Foundation and its Fight4Rare initiative, helping ignite hope and advance rare disease treatment and research.

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 17th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Sonic 35th Anniversary Megabundle by IDW
expires_today.long_description:
Celebrate 35 years of Sonic the Hedgehog with this megabundle of Sonic comics from IDW! What kinds of mischief have Sonic, his pals, and Dr. Eggman gotten into outside of the video games? Now you can find out! Catch the Blue Blur speeding through the pages of the official Sonic the Hedgehog comic series, collected together in 21 volumes of adventure and fun! Stay up to speed on all the Sonic mini-series like Imposter Syndrome, Tangle & Whisper, and Fang the Hunter! Enjoy all your favorite stories plus all the bonus content featured in Sonic’s 30th Anniversary Deluxe Edition! This bundle is perfect for diehard Sonic fans and newcomers alike, so snag it at the price of your choosing before it speeds away, and support Children’s Miracle Network with your purchase!

Keys expire. All titles should be redeemed before July 11, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Game Audio Collection - Access to over 300,000 music tracks and sound effects
expires_within_72h.description: A massive, 300,000+ audio asset bundle awaits!
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Create the perfect audioscape for your next game for a price you choose with three unique asset bundle options from the pros at Audio Hero. Highlights from this gigantic library of 300,000+ commercial-ready assets include themed voice packs for a variety of ages, realistic animal sounds, and more, alongside curated genre-specific tunes! Explore a variety of genres, from Latin to jazz and everything in between. Each tier unlocks additional assets—get the raw tools you need to achieve the sound you’re looking for, and support Children's Miracle Network Hospitals with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before July 27nd, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Red Team & Blue Team: The Hacker's Complete Playbook by Packt
expires_within_72h.description: Get Defending APIs, Digital Forensics Cookbook and more!
expires_within_72h.long_description: Turn your curiosity about computer hacking into a fast-paced, proven, and ethical career with our latest collaboration with the tech experts at Packt. Pay what you want for industry-leading insights from eBooks like Cybersecurity Blue Team Strategies and Cybersecurity Attacks - Red Team Strategies, all designed to help you combat bad hackers and secure your slice of cyberspace. Learn the latest defensive and offensive cybersecurity techniques and deepen your understanding, whether you’re a novice or a seasoned professional. Take control of your future, and help support The Global FoodBanking Network!
